crossRefs.note: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the…
He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along…

translations.web: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’
translations.bsb: So we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father. If he were to leave, his father would die.’
translations.kjv: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
translations.asv: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
